questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to architect cross-region privacy-preserving data pipelines with regulatory considerations, and to pick services for ingestion, storage, compute, and governance.

## Key Concepts
- Event-driven ingestion (Event Hubs) with regional data residency
- Delta Lake on ADLS Gen2 per region
- Real-time masking/tokenization in Spark (Databricks)
- Cross-region analytics with governed data sharing
- BYOK, Purview governance, DR to paired region
- Cost levers: auto-scale compute, tiered storage, data masking overhead

## Code Example
```python
# PySpark pseudo-masking inside Databricks
raw = spark.read.format('delta').load('<region>/delta/raw')
masked = raw.withColumn('user_id_masked', sha2(col('user_id'), 256))
masked.write.format('delta').mode('append').save('<region>/delta/masked')
```
